name: KitchenTimerIcon
brief: Original Kitchen Timer: arched charcoal-sage housing with integrated feet, ivory dial, red 35-minute sector and large diagonal winding paddle. Generated raster first, rebuilt as editable geometry.

semantic_review.basis: Original generated concept, no external brand identity. Reconstructed silhouette and component relationships; controlled geometric gradients simplify photographic shading.
semantic_review.notes: Five semantic foreground layers plus background. Red reduced from neon generated red to approved warm vermilion; twelve marks made mathematically regular. No bitmap traced or embedded. Android adaptation separately scales foreground into mask safe zone. Overlay confirmed aligned source silhouette/dial geometry. Difference hotspots were housing and knob shading; refined broad surface gradients and explicit molded edge, without noisy raster texture or filters. Independent root review accepted silhouette/face/sector/paddle semantic match and editable material approximation; final narrow pass widened upper-left bezel light and added gradient contact shadow under knob. Strict pixel reproduction is not claimed.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: Preserve original arched housing/feet, ivory circular face, red 35-minute sector, twelve dark marks and diagonal ivory winding paddle. Material is intentionally simplified into editable broad gradients.
